methodologyNotes: Thirteen trailer brake controllers spanning proportional, time-delay, and Bluetooth-app-controlled designs were verified 2026-08-12 against manufacturer product pages (Tekonsha, CURT, REDARC) and authorized-dealer/retailer listings (Amazon, Reese Towpower, State Trailer Supply, etrailer.com) that reproduce manufacturer spec sheets, with two adversarial corrections made to the seed list: the seed "CURT Assure" does not exist as a current SKU (CURT's discontinued proportional model in that market position was the TriFlex, #51140, whose official substitute product per curtmfg.com is the TriFlex NEXT, #51146 — used here), and "Reese Brakeman Digital" does not match any current Reese SKU so it was mapped to the actual current model bearing a digital output, the Brakeman IV Time-Delay Brake Controller (#8507120); the seed "Hopkins Agility" could not be confirmed to exist under Hopkins Towing Solutions' current lineup (hopkinstowingsolutions.com was unreachable and no retailer listing under that name was found), so it was dropped rather than guessed, while "Tekonsha Primus IQ" (#90160) and "Tekonsha Prodigy iD" were checked and the Primus IQ was confirmed real and retained; unresolved fields (notably amperage on Draw-Tite Activator IV and CURT's Echo/Spectrum/TriFlex NEXT lines, and most consumer pricing, which manufacturers largely omit from their own sites) are left null rather than estimated.
